notes.title: Space Depot Official Release!
notes.content: [h1]Release Day![/h1][p][/p][p]Good Morning Depot Managers, [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for checking out Space Depot. Since I can remember I've wanted to make my own video game. When I was young my brother and I would spend our Friday nights at Blockbuster, searching for that ever elusive co-op game. Many nights were spent mastering new games and many, many, late fees accrued. I'm so proud to announce that at 1pm EST and 10am PST I'll be releasing Space Depot to the Steam Store. [/p][p][/p][p]Many years later I set out to make my first game about moving boxes. You'll take control of a Space Depot far from earth all from the comfort of your own home. I hate tight spaces...so there is no way I think real space travel would be my thing. However, telecommuting billions of miles to operate a Space Depot from the comfort of my own home sounds like a dream. I also believe that artists help build the world we live in through ideas and creative expression. Everything that we see as the future first existed in someone's dreams and imagination. I hope you enjoy imagining and playing in a future where scarcity is proven to be false and everyone, no matter where they are in the galaxy, has what they need. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you from the bottom of my heart for purchasing and playing Space Depot. It means the world to me. There is much more to come for Space Depot. Stay tuned in and stay awesome. [/p][p][/p][p]Kindest Regards,[/p][p]Zenventorymgmt[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
